divergences.cause: Existing watchdog ignored acquisition-cycle inactivity when a frame was already active. Guardian.tick rearms before counting that active cycle; with limit one the repeated acquisition immediately trips.
divergences.resolution: Align watchdog RTL with the unchanged model. Count an active non-progress acquisition cycle as age one and expose its limit-one expiry. This is a Gate 1 semantic correction, not an infrastructure repair.

divergences.cause: Python push_tx/pop_rx calls occur between actor ticks; RTL host pulses commit synchronously using old FIFO state.
divergences.resolution: Recorder explicitly schedules host actions after actor tick and uses pre-tick pop validity. Same-edge full RX decision/pop is separately tested to NACK the incoming byte. Model source is unchanged.
